_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Opening a live room in Metodic…

description: Set a Metodic session up to RUN LIVE with the room: participants join on their phones (no account, no app) and answer the session's polls, quizzes, word clouds and questions while the facilitator runs it from the Run view or the Presenter View. Returns the join code, a QR code, the participant link and the facilitator's links, shown in the chat. Reuses the session's open live room instead of making a second one. Free. Use it whenever the user wants to run, present, facilitate or 'go live' with a session, or asks how people join.

start_now.description: true = open the room right away, so phones that join see the first activity. Default false: the code is ready and the facilitator presses Start in the Run view.

name: run_live
title: Run it live
